raw: [name="Zuo Xuanliao"]He has always been like this.
speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: He has always been like this.

raw: The more whimsical encounters there are, the more ties one needs to let go of.
content: The more whimsical encounters there are, the more ties one needs to let go of.

raw: Man values formality, beasts value empathy.
content: Man values formality, beasts value empathy.

raw: [name="Patrol Battalion Soldier"]Rescue and relief efforts have begun, sir.
speaker: Patrol Battalion Soldier
content: Rescue and relief efforts have begun, sir.

speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: Very well.

speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: ...The sun is setting.

speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: Oh, the Wangfeng Festival...

raw: [name="Patrol Battalion Soldier"]Yesterday was the last day, but the beacon-lighting ceremony was suspended because of the Catastrophe.
speaker: Patrol Battalion Soldier
content: Yesterday was the last day, but the beacon-lighting ceremony was suspended because of the Catastrophe.

raw: [name="Patrol Battalion Soldier"]Would you like to resume it?
speaker: Patrol Battalion Soldier
content: Would you like to resume it?

speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: Of course.

raw: The wizened general gazes beyond the city and sees nothing but sand.
content: The wizened general gazes beyond the city and sees nothing but sand.

raw: [name="Zuo Xuanliao"]I will beat the drum myself.
speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: I will beat the drum myself.

raw: [name="Patrol Battalion Soldier"]Sir, you've been in the tower all day. You should rest. We'll take care of it.
speaker: Patrol Battalion Soldier
content: Sir, you've been in the tower all day. You should rest. We'll take care of it.

raw: [name="Zuo Xuanliao"]The journey is long. Someone should see him off.
speaker: Zuo Xuanliao
content: The journey is long. Someone should see him off.

raw: All your companions have returned. Where do you fly off to, alone?
content: All your companions have returned. Where do you fly off to, alone?

raw: [ImageTween(xFrom=-80, yFrom=0, xTo=50, yTo=0, xScaleTo=0.9, yScaleTo=0.9, duration=35, block=false)]

content: The drumbeats begin.

raw: They are heavy, ringing clear and far.
content: They are heavy, ringing clear and far.

raw: Seventeen beats of the drum, representing the trials and tribulations that befell Yumen the past year, both big and small.
content: Seventeen beats of the drum, representing the trials and tribulations that befell Yumen the past year, both big and small.

raw: The Catastrophe has passed. The storm has swept away the many colors in the sky.
content: The Catastrophe has passed. The storm has swept away the many colors in the sky.

raw: The clouds burn bright red, scorched by the setting sun.
content: The clouds burn bright red, scorched by the setting sun.

raw: He walks forward, the wind and sand slowly wiping away his footprints. The great city of Yumen grows smaller in the distance.
content: He walks forward, the wind and sand slowly wiping away his footprints. The great city of Yumen grows smaller in the distance.
Thump—
Eighteen.

raw: He stops briefly, but does not turn.
content: He stops briefly, but does not turn.

raw: The eighteenth beat of the drum, symbolizing yet another Catastrophe survived by Yumen.
content: The eighteenth beat of the drum, symbolizing yet another Catastrophe survived by Yumen.
And...

speaker: Chongyue
content: I'll be going.

content: We made it out.

content: Thank you for digging up the Patrol Battalion's activities, or we would have been goners inside.

speaker: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
content: (Grinds teeth)

speaker: Calm Shanhaizhong Member
content: Yumen... next time...

content: Hey, isn't that the one who...?

speaker: Calm Shanhaizhong Member

speaker: Qiubai
content: Followed? I just stopped to take a break on my way out of Yumen.

raw: [name="Qiubai"]But I guess fate meant for us to meet again.
speaker: Qiubai
content: But I guess fate meant for us to meet again.

speaker: Qiubai
content: Perfect. I'll send you on your way.
